literal_meaning: খালি (empty) এর দ্বিত্বশব্দ (re duplication of empty)
figurative_meaning_en: A reduplicated expression suggesting a sense of near-emptiness or void
example_sentences_in_english: The house feels so empty and hollow.
My heart feels empty and void.
note: This is a common reduplicative idiom in colloquial Bengali to emphasize a pervasive sense of emptiness.
